description: Combined PRD evidence from two isolated Codex/Ralph stream worktrees. Verification and PR gate run on this integration branch.

userStories.title: Return complete MCP ObjectType resource schema bundles
userStories.description: As an MCP client, I want resources/read to return ObjectType properties and outgoing link metadata so agents can reason over ontology schemas without falling back to REST endpoints.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given an ontology with an ObjectType that has properties and outgoing links, when resources/read is called for weave://objecttype/<ontology>/<objectType>, then the JSON content includes objectType, properties, and outgoingLinkTypes.
Given resources/read is called for a weave://ontology/<rid> resource, when the ontology contains ObjectTypes with properties, then each ObjectType in the ontology bundle includes its properties.
Given the OMS repository cannot list properties or outgoing links, when resources/read is called, then MCP returns a JSON-RPC tool error instead of silently returning partial schema data.

userStories.title: Reject invalid JSON-RPC id shapes in MCP transports
userStories.description: As an MCP transport client, I want invalid JSON-RPC id values to be rejected with standard invalid-request errors so malformed envelopes do not leak unsupported response IDs.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given a JSON-RPC request whose id is an object or array, when the HTTP MCP endpoint receives it, then the response is HTTP 200 with JSON-RPC error code -32600 and id null.
Given a stdio MCP request whose id is an object or array, when the bridge parses it, then stdout receives a JSON-RPC error line with code -32600 and id null.
Given string, number, or null ids, when MCP parses the envelope, then existing request handling and id round-tripping still work.

userStories.title: Harden stream ingest metadata validation against schema drift
userStories.description: As an ingest writer, I want stream ingest to reject object properties that no longer exist in OMS metadata before publishing to Funnel so accepted batches cannot become invisible or partially indexed.
bddAcceptanceCriteria: Given an ingest edit contains an object property not declared on the target ObjectType, when the stream ingest endpoint validates the batch, then it returns InvalidIngestEdit and does not publish.

Given a valid batch containing only declared properties, when the stream ingest endpoint validates the batch, then it publishes the batch unchanged except for source=ingest and URL objectType enforcement.
Given metadata lookup fails, when ingest validation runs, then the endpoint returns a stable server-side metadata lookup error and does not publish.

userStories.title: Reset Browser route-scoped state when switching object types
userStories.context: BrowserPage currently keeps committed search text, filters, selected facets, selected rows, pagination, detail state, and live subscription state in component-local state. React Router can reuse the same BrowserPage instance when navigating between /browser/:ontology/:objectType routes, so stale fields or selected primary keys from one object type can leak into the next object grid.

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Given an operator has searched and selected rows on one object type, when they navigate to another /browser/:ontology/:objectType route, then the search input, active search/filter state, selected rows, detail panel, pagination, and bulk toolbar reset for the new object type.
Given the route changes to a new object type, when the new object grid loads, then BrowserPage does not send the previous object type's search/filter where clause to the new object type.

Given live updates were enabled for the previous object type, when the route changes, then BrowserPage resets the live/objectSet subscription state instead of reusing a subscription RID created for the previous object type.

bddTests: web/src/components/browser/__tests__/BrowserPage.test.tsx adds a BDD scenario that navigates between two object types in the same BrowserPage instance and asserts stale search/selection state is cleared.
